note: RELEASE-FACING DEFAULTS for the server-catalog sync, and the ONLY place the catalog address and pinned signing key are written. Current profile: private-network (LAN) development catalog, accepted only from a private address and only while it verifies against the pinned public key. To go to production, replace baseUrl with the public https address (and add the production PUBLIC key); nothing else in the launcher changes. Only PUBLIC keys belong here, never a private key or secret. Players never see or edit these values; they are developer options (Settings > System > Developer options).
